title: Atmosphere
description: Current atmospheric contract only represents atmosphere presence, optional surface pressure and optional primary components. This object carries no source/provenance field and no atmospheric exclusion/edge altitude. surfacePressurePa null or absent means unknown/unavailable; it must not be converted into an altitude. A numeric exclusion altitude, its unknown-state encoding and provenance semantics are unsupported and require backend data/model/serialization changes before they can be contracted.

hasAtmosphere.description: Current asserted presence flag; the contract does not expose an evidence/provenance field for this assertion.

surfacePressurePa.description: Surface pressure in pascals. Null/absent is unknown, not zero; it does not imply an atmospheric boundary or exclusion altitude.

primaryComponents.description: Current component labels; no per-component source/provenance is represented.
